name: B10-0349/2026 (PfE) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Pakistan to act. It asks Pakistan to protect religious minority girls, to return Maria Shahbaz to her family, to enforce its new ban on child marriage, and to scrap its blasphemy laws. It also asks the European Union to check whether Pakistan still meets the conditions for its trade benefits, and to punish those responsible for crimes against women in Lahore.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Pakistan and the European Union to act.
- **Who it affects:** Pakistan's government and courts, religious minority girls there, and European Union trade policy.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to Pakistan and European Union bodies. No decision is binding.
